w09-passport.observed_description: Seen from behind a hotel front desk: Ana (long dark wavy hair, sage-green overshirt over a white top, jeans) smiles and holds out a plain dark-red passport toward the camera, her dark-blue suitcase beside her; the receptionist's shoulder is a soft blur at the right edge.
w09-passport.note: Usable: Ana matches the reference, the passport is plain, and the small paper on the desk is a blur with nothing readable.
